questions.statement: The two countries will sign the agreement ________ both parties agree on the environmental clauses.
questions.context: Setting a condition for a trade agreement.

options.feedback: Correct! "Provided that" is a formal way to say "if" or "only if".

questions.explanation:
*Provided that* (siempre que/con la condición de que) se utiliza en contextos formales, como el comercio internacional, para establecer una condición necesaria para un resultado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Global trade will suffer ________ nations find a way to reduce transportation costs.
questions.context: Expressing a negative condition in production.

options.feedback: Correct! "Unless" means "except if" or "if they don't".
Incorrect. This would mean trade suffers *while* they find a way.

questions.explanation:
Utilizamos *unless* para introducir una excepción o una condición negativa ("a menos que"). Equivale a *if... not*.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: We should insure the cargo ________ there is a storm during the crossing.
questions.context: Taking a precaution in international shipping.

options.feedback: Incorrect. We don't want the storm to be the condition for insuring.
Correct! "In case" is used to talk about precautions for something that might happen.

questions.explanation:
*In case* (por si acaso) se utiliza para describir una acción realizada por precaución, preparándose para una posibilidad futura incierta.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"How long will the partnership last?"
"It will continue ________ both companies remain profitable."
questions.context: Discussing the longevity of a partnership.

options.feedback: Correct! "As long as" emphasizes the duration and the condition simultaneously.

questions.explanation:
*As long as* (mientras/siempre que) es similar a *provided that*, pero a menudo pone más énfasis en el tiempo durante el cual la condición sigue siendo válida.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The government will increase taxes on imports ________ the local industry shows significant growth.
questions.context: Using a condition for local market protection.

options.feedback: Correct! Logical meaning: Taxes will increase IF the industry doesn't grow.
Incorrect. (Wait, B is better for a threat/policy).

questions.explanation:
En políticas económicas, *unless* se usa para establecer metas o hitos que, de no cumplirse, provocarán una reacción (como el aumento de impuestos).

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Many people will continue buying imported goods ________ they are cheaper than local products.
questions.context: Discussing consumer choice in a global market.

options.feedback: Correct! "So long as" is a synonym for "as long as", common in B2 level.

questions.explanation:
*So long as* es una variante de *as long as* que se utiliza para reforzar una condición necesaria para que un comportamiento persista.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence suggests that the action is a **precaution**?

options.text: I will call the supplier if there is a delay.
options.feedback: Incorrect. I will only call AFTER the delay happens.

options.text: I will call the supplier in case there is a delay.
options.feedback: Correct! I call now or prepare to call to be ready for the possibility.

options.text: I will call the supplier unless there is a delay.
I will call the supplier as long as there is a delay.

questions.explanation:
A nivel B2, es crucial entender que *in case* implica preparación previa, mientras que *if* implica una reacción posterior al evento.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "The factory will close ________ the workers accept a pay cut."

options.feedback: Incorrect. That would be a good thing.
Correct! "Even if" shows that the result will not change, regardless of the condition.

questions.explanation:
*Even if* (incluso si) se utiliza para expresar que una consecuencia es inevitable y no se verá afectada por el cumplimiento o no de la condición.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Ships are allowed to pass through the canal ________ they follow the safety protocols.

options.feedback: Correct! Highly formal synonym for "provided that".

questions.explanation:
*On condition that* es la forma más explícita y formal de establecer un requisito legal o contractual en inglés avanzado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Identify the error in this paragraph:
"The economy will grow **provided that** (A) we export more. **Unless** (B) the government doesn't reduce tariffs, trade will be difficult. We should save reserves **in case** (C) the global market crashes. **As long as** (D) we stay competitive, we will succeed."
questions.context: Identifying an error in a trade report.

options.feedback: Correct! "Unless" already has a negative meaning. Using it with "doesn't reduce" creates a double negative. It should be "Unless the government reduces" or "If the government doesn't reduce".

questions.explanation:
Un error muy común es usar *unless* con un verbo en negativo. Como *unless* ya significa "si no", el verbo que le sigue debe estar siempre en afirmativo.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: A company wants to state that they will only pay if the products are perfect. Which sentence is best?
questions.context: Choosing the most precise condition for a contract.

options.text: We pay if the products are perfect.
We pay in case the products are perfect.
Payment will be made provided that the goods meet all quality standards.
options.feedback: Correct! Formal, precise, and uses B2 structures correctly.

options.text: We won't pay unless the products are perfect, even if we like them.

questions.explanation:
La precisión en el uso de conjunciones condicionales es vital para redactar documentos que no dejen lugar a ambigüedades en el mundo de los negocios.

questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Choose the best completion:
"Globalization offers opportunities, ________ nations are prepared to adapt. ________ they invest in education, they will lose competitiveness. They must also have backup plans ________ a new global crisis occurs."
questions.context: Completing a summary of global economic challenges.

options.text: as long as / If / in case

options.feedback: Correct! Accurate sequence of condition, negative condition, and precaution.

questions.explanation: Este ejercicio final evalúa la integración de tres tipos diferentes de conectores condicionales para expresar una visión económica compleja y matizada.
